identity.bone_region: TP root and lateral SAP neck

reference_policy: Freeze an ultrasound-independent external cortical reference. Keep all plausible hypotheses. If unresolved, never score historical midpoint proximity as anatomical correctness.

reference_technical_gate.space: robot base mm with public probe-to-image calibration; reference transformed by evaluator after prediction seal
reference_technical_gate.distance_statistic: P95 of each of the two directed nearest distances
reference_technical_gate.across_hypotheses: all, with each score separately reported
reference_technical_gate.criterion_scope: technical for the simulator, no clinical tolerance

arms.E0: archived historical TP/SAP only, original localizer, matched recordings
arms.E3: optional single matched fresh development run after evaluating missing evidence
arms.ablation: new localizer on identical input with only semantic TP/SAP anchors

independent_readiness: Four localized and anatomically evaluable matches in E2, no wrong accepted region, resolved integrity and sufficient time. Held-out seeds closed otherwise.
